node.title: Re^3: "Cannot find location"
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Same thing: Can't locate Digest/MD5/File.pm in @INC (@INC contains: /root/perl5/lib/perl5 ...

I guess you have a Perl version [doc://perl5180delta#require-dies-for-unreadable-files|lower than 5.18]:

When [doc://require] encounters an unreadable file, it now dies. It used to ignore the file and continue searching the directories in @INC [https://rt.perl.org/Public/Bug/Display.html?id=113422|[perl #113422]].
# Perl 5.10 $ perl -I/root -MTesting Can't locate Testing.pm in @INC (@INC contains: /root ... # Perl 5.24 $ perl -I/root -MTesting Can't locate Testing.pm: /root/Testing.pm: Permission denied.
